rounds.text: The company’s recent financial performance reveals a severe deterioration in profitability, evidenced by a 52% decline in trailing twelve-month profit growth [E13] and a 17% contraction over the last three years [E12]. This downward trend is further confirmed by a significant 27% year-over-year drop in sales [E54], suggesting that the business is struggling to maintain its market position. Operating margins have compressed by 4 percentage points over the last three years, falling from 10% to 6% [E19], which highlights a structural weakness in the company's ability to generate value from its operations. Furthermore, the stock offers no dividend yield to shareholders [E4], and the current valuation is increasingly disconnected from reality as price growth has outpaced profit growth by 18% [E44].
